item.title: Study Deepens Understanding of Quantum Transport in Topological Materials
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — In May, a study was published in Nature Communications that identified an unusual regime of quantum oscillations in a three-dimensional topological insulator. The results show that, when subjected to temperatures near absolute zero and extreme magnetic fields, electrons in the material zirconium pentatelluride (ZrTe₅) exhibit behavior that deviates from the pattern predicted by conventional […]
